decisions.impact: Prevented thermal overload and preserved manufacturing output.

decisions.decision: Opened encrypted binharic channel to Spire High Command requesting munition and ration relief.

decisions.decision: Utilized command autonomy to integrate salvaged brass water valves into the shell-press cooling lines, accelerating the second macro-shell tithe batch by 30%.
decisions.impact: Brought the level within reach of earning the Spire's emergency supply drop.
